chunks: And ʿAmmār ibn Mūsā al-Sābāṭī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

"Praise be to Allah, the Splitter of the dawn. Glory be to Allah, the Lord of evening and morning. O Allah, bring morning upon the family of Muḥammad with blessing, well-being, joy, and comfort of the eye. O Allah, You send down in the night and the day whatever You will, so send down upon me and upon my household from the blessings of the heavens and the earth a lawful, good, abundant provision by which You make me free of need from all Your creation."

key_terms.آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ: the family of Muḥammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, for whom blessing is invoked
key_terms.الْفَجْرُ: the dawn, the time when this supplication is to be said
key_terms.بَرَكَةٍ: blessing, increase in divine good and benefit
key_terms.تُغْنِينِي: make me free of need, enrich me against dependence on others
key_terms.رِزْقًا حَلَالًا طَيِّبًا وَاسِعًا: a lawful, wholesome, and abundant provision
key_terms.فَالِقِ الْإِصْبَاحِ: the Splitter of the dawn, describing Allah as the One who brings forth morning

ai.seo_question: What supplication should be recited at the time of dawn for blessing and halal provision?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication to be recited at the rising of dawn, beginning with praise and glorification of Allah and then invoking blessings for Āl Muḥammad. It also asks Allah for halal, pure, and expansive sustenance descending from the blessings of the heavens and the earth, sufficient to remove need from dependence on creation.
